name: argus-actions
description: GitHub Actions runs, approvals and workflow dispatch in the Argus Control Centre

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Argus Actions runs the gh CLI against your repo.

argus.actions.repo.description: GitHub repo (owner/name) to show Actions runs for. Defaults to the GitHub origin remote of the first workspace folder that has one.

argus.actions.refreshSeconds.description: How often the Actions tab refreshes while it is visible.

argus.actions.backgroundRefreshSeconds.description: How often approvals are checked while the Actions tab is not visible.

argus.actions.appPattern.description: Optional regular expression matched against job names to label a run with the app it touches. The first capture group, or the whole match, names the app.
